description: CO2-uitstoot is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Infrabel berekent zijn CO2-uitstoot sinds 2019 op basis van de Greenhouse Gas Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard. In 2024 liet Infrabel zijn aanpak voor de opmaak van zijn geconsolideerde 1 CO2-balans certificeren op basis van de ISO14064-3:2019 standaard. De certificatie omvatte de verificatie van de berekeningen voor 2019 (basisjaar) en 2023 (laatst beschikbare cijfers). Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Milieu. Its keywords are CO2-uitstoot, ISO14064, CO2-emissies, GHG protocol. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
